answer: Yes. The applicable manufacturer API expressly guarantees true-random output when its internal SAR entropy source has been enabled by bootloader_random_enable and not disabled. The exact P4 minrev300/hw_ver3 official SDK path enables ADC1 and LP_TRNG, and esp_random reads the rev3 RNG_DATA_REG. These sources provide sufficient manufacturer/interface assurance for the narrowly scoped future claim below. No identified applicable P4-rev3.2 erratum or source contradiction defeats that conditional claim. The preliminary TRM does not independently establish every connection to the new data register; this limits stronger physical-source attribution rather than adding an unstated P01 prerequisite to the supported-path claim.

Adoption relies on the manufacturer's conditional true-random assurance and verified application ownership/configuration/invocation/failure boundaries. It does not independently prove internal physical routing or per-draw entropy quality.

primary_sources.meaning: Target-parametric manufacturer API. The no-RF SAR branch applies to P4. True-random guarantee requires helper enabled/not disabled, with physical noise continuously mixed. Without a documented main-source condition output is pseudorandom only. Secondary-source text101 retains the main-source requirement; getrandom/getentropy inherit it and add no health assurance.

Official helper configures ADC1 channel10/12dB, calibration2166, digital controller/software-on, XTAL/divider0, SARdiv15, trigger100. HAL minrev>=300 adds trng_ll_enable. Cleanup disables the configured source paths. Do not replace this combined configuration with an ADC1-only or TRNG-only physical theory.
Actual controller clock/pattern/power/trigger writes and analog ent=1/dtest=0 init; deinit clears ent. These support configuration, not an independent physical-noise health measurement.
Enable clock/reset/timer XOR/sample; disable sample/timer/clock.8-bit sample counter is diagnostic, no entropy-quality status.
RNG_DATA_REG is DR_REG_LP_TRNG_BASE+4. Sample bit enables RO; timer bit enables asynchronous timer XOR. This is not the older TRM LP_SYSTEM output address.

P4-specific sampling/wait policy, WDEV reads/XOR and RTC mixing retained. Use unchanged manufacturer API rather than direct faster register draws/custom conditioner. uint32 return provides no health/error status.
P4 hardware RNG/RTC support. SOC_WIFI_SUPPORTED/SOC_BT_SUPPORTED/SOC_IEEE802154_SUPPORTED absent; similarly named sleep/wakeup capability names do not enable those conditions.
Exact boot application path disables bootloader randomness before app. Startup defaults do not establish provider readiness.
